The posterior mean is computed with distribution validation off, so a NaN latent is saved and recorded as nonfinite_latent instead of crashing. (by agent (implementation of PREREG sec. 1); flagged to the lead for confirmation)
- [NB-20261003-12](2026-10-03.md) Infrastructure errors: at most --max-attempts 2 per tag and kind in a run, then no new work is started, running work finishes, exit 5 with the log path. Claims: owner identified by host, /etc/machine-id, boot time, pid namespace, pid and process start; an owner whose liveness cannot be checked (other host, container, sandbox, no machine-id) is 'foreign' and needs --clear-foreign-claims; only verifiably dead owners are 'stale' (--clear-stale-claims). Outputs that break the fitter/scorer contract are moved to OUT/quarantine/, never deleted. Fits read a snapshot of the manifest (OUT/manifests/<sha>.tsv). A scoring-only run skips the fit-device probe. (by agent (implementation))
